# Preparation

## Packages and appearance

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| echo: true
#| message: false
#| warning: false

if (!require("pacman")) {
  install.packages("pacman")
  library(pacman)
}
p_load(here, rio, brms, cmdstanr, tidybayes, ggdist, posterior, bayesplot, loo, marginaleffects, tinytable, tidyverse)

options(rio.import.trust = TRUE)

```

## Load total data set

```{r}
#| label: getdata
#| message: false

pb <- import(here("data", "processed", "pb7724.rds"))

```

Do votes add up to 100% ?

```{r}

check_votes <- pb |> 
filter(!is.na(pvote)) |>  # exclude missing vote intentions
count(year, pvote)  |> 
group_by(year) |> 
mutate(
vote_share = 100 * n / sum(n)
) |> 
summarise(
total_share = sum(vote_share)
)

check_votes

```

## Class and SPD votes

```{r}

pb |>
  filter(!is.na(worker), !is.na(spd)) |> 
  group_by(year, spd) |> 
  summarise(mean_class = weighted.mean(worker, weight, na.rm = TRUE)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = mean_class, color = as.factor(spd)))+
  geom_smooth()+
  theme_light()

```

## Aggregate Bayesian model

```{r}

priors_loyalty <- c(
  prior(normal(0, 1.5), class = "Intercept"),
  prior(normal(0, 1),   class = "b", coef = "worker"),
  prior(exponential(2), class = "sd"),
  prior(lkj(2),         class = "cor")
)

pb_agg <- pb |>
  filter(year> 2012 & year < 2025) |> 
  count(year, worker, afd) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = afd, values_from = n, values_fill = 0,
                      names_prefix = "afd_") |>
  mutate(n_total = afd_0 + afd_1) |> 
  filter(!is.na(worker))

m2a_prior_check <- brm(
  afd_1 | trials(n_total) ~ worker + (1 + worker | year),
  data         = pb_agg,
  family       = binomial(),
  prior        = priors_loyalty,
  backend      = "cmdstanr",
  threads      = threading(4),
  sample_prior = "only",   # draws from prior, ignores the likelihood entirely
  chains = 4, cores = 4, seed = 1
)

prior_pred <- pb_agg |>
  distinct(year, worker) |>
  mutate(n_total = 1) |>
  add_linpred_draws(m2a_prior_check, transform = TRUE, ndraws = 200) |>
  rename(p_afd = .linpred)

library(ggplot2)
ggplot(prior_pred, aes(x = year, y = p_afd, group = .draw)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.05) +
  facet_wrap(~ worker) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(y = "Prior-implied Pr(AfD | worker, year)")

prior_draws(m2a_prior_check) |>
  select(starts_with("sd_")) |>
  summary()
```

## Loyalty -- Pr(afd|worker)

```{r}

pb_afd <- pb |> 
  filter(year > 2012 & year < 2025)

priors_loyalty <- c(
  prior(normal(0, 1.5), class = "Intercept"),
  prior(normal(0, 1),   class = "b", coef = "worker"),
  prior(exponential(1), class = "sd"),
  prior(lkj(2),         class = "cor")
)

m0 <- brm(afd | weights(weight) ~ worker,
          data = pb_afd,
          family = bernoulli(),
          prior = priors_loyalty[1:2, ],
          chains = 4, cores = 4, seed = 1,
          backend      = "cmdstanr",
          threads      = threading(4),
          file = here("models", "pb_afd_m0"))

m1 <- brm(afd | weights(weight) ~ worker + (1 | year),
          data = pb_afd, family = bernoulli(),
          prior = priors_loyalty[c(1,2,3), ],
          chains = 4, cores = 4, seed = 1,
          backend      = "cmdstanr",
          threads      = threading(4),
          file = here("models", "pb_afd_m1"))

m2a <- brm(afd | weights(weight) ~ worker + (1 + worker | year),
           data = pb_afd, family = bernoulli(),
           prior = priors_loyalty,
           chains = 4, cores = 4, seed = 1,
           backend = "cmdstanr",
           threads = threading(4),
           file = here("models", "pb_afd_m2a"))

# Rhat < 1.01, bulk/tail ESS for ALL params incl. group-level SDs
summary(m2a) 
# binary DV, check calibration by year
pp_check(m2a) 
# loo_compare(loo(m0), loo(m1), loo(m2a))

```

```{r}

icv_by_year <- pb_afd |>
  distinct(year) |>
  tidyr::crossing(worker = c(0, 1)) |>
  add_epred_draws(m2a) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(-.row) |>
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(year, .chain, .iteration, .draw),
    names_from = worker, values_from = .epred, names_prefix = "p_worker"
  ) |> 
  mutate(icv = p_worker1 - p_worker0)

icv_by_year |>
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(year), y = icv)) +
  stat_gradientinterval()+
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
             color = "#c3c2b7", linewidth = 0.4) +   # baseline/axis gray, not a data hue
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(accuracy = 1)) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "P(AfD | worker) \u2212 P(AfD | non-worker)",
    title = "Class voting gap in AfD support, by survey year",
    caption = "Posterior median, 66% and 95% credible intervals"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.line.x = element_line(color = "#c3c2b7")
  )

```

## Contribution Pr(Worker | AfD)

```{r}

priors_contribution <- c(
  prior(normal(0, 1.5), class = "Intercept"),
  prior(normal(0, 1),   class = "b", coef = "afd"),
  prior(exponential(1), class = "sd"),
  prior(lkj(2),         class = "cor")
)

m2a_contrib <- brm(
  worker | weights(weight) ~ afd + (1 + afd | year),
  data = pb_afd, family = bernoulli(link = "logit"),
  prior = priors_contribution,
  backend = "cmdstanr",
  threads = threading(4),
  chains = 4, cores = 4, seed = 1,
  file = here("models", "pb_afd_m2a_contrib"))

contribution_by_year <- pb_afd |>
  distinct(year) |>
  tidyr::crossing(afd = c(0, 1)) |>
  add_epred_draws(m2a_contrib) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(-.row) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = afd, values_from = .epred, names_prefix = "p_afd")

contribution_by_year |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(year), y = p_afd1)) +
  stat_gradientinterval()+
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 0.5))+
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.line.x = element_line(color = "#c3c2b7")
  )
```

## Estimated share of workers to then calculate PCI

```{r}

priors_worker_share <- c(
  prior(normal(0, 1.5), class = "Intercept"),
  prior(exponential(1), class = "sd")
)

m_worker_share <- brm(
  worker | weights(weight) ~ 1 + (1 | year),
  data   = pb_afd,
  family = bernoulli(),
  prior  = priors_worker_share,
  backend = "cmdstanr",
  threads = threading(4),
  chains = 4, cores = 4, seed = 1,
  file = here("models", "pb_workers_share")
)

worker_share_draws <- pb_afd |>
  distinct(year) |>
  add_epred_draws(m_worker_share) |>
  ungroup() |>
  rename(worker_share = .epred) |>
  select(year, .draw, worker_share)

pci_by_year <- pb_afd |>
  distinct(year) |>
  tidyr::crossing(afd = c(0, 1)) |>
  add_epred_draws(m2a_contrib) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(-.row) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = afd, values_from = .epred, names_prefix = "p_afd") |>
  left_join(worker_share_draws, by = c("year", ".draw")) |>
  mutate(pci = p_afd1 - worker_share)

pci_by_year |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(year), y = pci)) +
  stat_gradientinterval()+
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted")+
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.line.x = element_line(color = "#c3c2b7")
  )

```
